name: dsh-opencode-go-quota-settings
description: DSH plugin: OpenCode GO quota, model manager and connection settings in one compact settings page (three quota windows, per-model enable switches with filters, key card, models, all connection fields) — reuses the opencode-go model key, writes the route's model allowlist, keeps the generated config form off where dsh-go shows the page, plus a same-origin usage proxy and a /opencode-go-quota command
